title: CropType
description: Agricultural crop types for the GAP (Southeastern Anatolia Project) region. 8-crop set; HAZELNUT removed in v2.0.0 (not grown in GAP).

metadata.changeNote: MAJOR (breaking): HAZELNUT (Fındık) removed — hazelnut is a Black Sea crop, not grown in the GAP region; it was erroneously present. Migration: docs/migration_guides/crop_type_hazelnut_removal.md.

gapPriorities.description: GAP region priority crops (ALL 8 crops are GAP priorities - these are the ONLY supported crops)

aliases.description: Cross-repo / legacy name mapping. TarlaAnaliz (GAP) canonical value -> alternative names used by the sibling/worker vocabulary. Used only for interop translation, NOT as accepted enum values.

archived.HAZELNUT: Removed in v2.0.0. Hazelnut (Fındık) is a Black Sea region crop and is not grown in GAP; its presence was an error. Re-adding would be a MINOR change.

notes.breaking_change_policy: Adding new crop types is non-breaking (MINOR). Removing or renaming crop types is breaking (MAJOR) and requires migration guide.
notes.gap_region: GAP (Güneydoğu Anadolu Projesi) region includes: Adıyaman, Batman, Diyarbakır, Gaziantep, Kilis, Mardin, Siirt, Şanlıurfa, Şırnak
notes.usage: This enum is used across schemas (Field, Mission, Pricing) and UI components. Always reference this canonical source.
notes.worker_alignment: TarlaAnaliz uses the GAP 8-crop set and keeps its naming (MAIZE, RED_LENTIL). It is NOT 1:1 with the sibling/worker CropType, which uses CORN/LENTIL and Aegean crops (CHERRY/FIG/APPLE/PEACH). Translate across repos via metadata.aliases (MAIZE<->CORN, RED_LENTIL<->LENTIL).
